property_summary: For all callers and values, the reference contract allows SetMinSum(...) to succeed (not revert) before Initialized() is called and reverts after Initialized() is called; the mutant inverts the guard so it reverts before initialization and only allows changes after Initialized(), breaking this ordering property for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the initialization guard from 'if(intitalized) revert();' to 'if(!intitalized) revert();' so SetMinSum can only be called before initialization becomes true (inverted condition) — different behavior for MinSum after call.
